response.sql: SELECT AVG(spent / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget WHERE spent > 6;

assumptions.assumption: "Past the 6-dollar mark" means spent > 6 (strictly greater). Lines with NULL spent are excluded by this filter.

A ratio is missing when amount is NULL or 0; NULLIF turns a zero amount into NULL so AVG skips that line. The average is NULL (blank) if no line has a usable ratio. COUNT(*) counts every line with spent > 6, including lines whose ratio is missing.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only the qualifying lines that have a usable ratio, so the count matches the lines in the average.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(spent / amount) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget WHERE spent > 6 AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0;
